about: #553 (B1). The sigpipe audit's ceilings are now a row of gates/door-checks.sh (sigpipe-ceilings, read from gatemanifest.sh sigpipe's fixed 'sigpipe door: <held> pass / <breached> fail' line), so records-gate.sh --checks refuses a breach; the ceiling had been breached unseen twice (23 vs 15 at #550, 13 vs 12 on #553's lead branch at gates/fastgate.sh:2156, fixed here). The graded lines: GM-SP door, the live door row over this tree; GM-SP DC10*, the door's live list carries the row; GM-SP DC18*, the row over a copy of the real gates/ passes and the same copy one site past the committed ceiling refuses with the ceiling's own count line. Breaks: the fastgate.sh site put back (the actual recurrence), the door row deleted, and the door line reporting every ceiling held whatever the audit found. No browser and no bundle: the situation is the tree. NOT COVERED HERE: the gatemanifest-selftest row of gates/harness-case-counts.tsv (records-gate.sh --harnesses, about 10 minutes) - its own controls are harness-counts.sh --selftest HC15/15b/15c.
cmd: o=$(bash gates/door-checks.sh --only sigpipe-ceilings 2>&1); r=$?; if [ "$r" = 0 ]; then echo 'PASS GM-SP door: sigpipe-ceilings exit 0 over this tree'; else echo "FAIL GM-SP door: sigpipe-ceilings exit $r over this tree"; fi; printf '%s\n' "$o"; bash gates/door-checks.sh --selftest 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^  ok  \(DC1[08]\)/PASS GM-SP \1/p; s/^  FAIL \(DC1[08]\)/FAIL GM-SP \1/p'

breaks.name: fastgate-site-back
breaks.why: gates/fastgate.sh:2156 ends '| head -1' again, the site that took the total to 13 against the ceiling 12

breaks.name: door-row-gone
breaks.why: the sigpipe-ceilings row is deleted from door-checks.sh's list, so nothing on the push path runs the audit again

breaks.name: door-line-hides-a-breach
breaks.why: the 'sigpipe door:' line reports every ceiling held and none breached whatever the audit counted
